findings.required_change: Replace short/long with total and short in the protocol and matching configuration descriptions; keep 504 bins,39armZscores,mtDNA and source parameters.

findings.problem: 12/7/10 are full Kremer-cohort workload endpoints at Par16, not the30sample subsampling recovery endpoint at Par18. Current configuration result list places them in the subsampling evaluation, with metric_direction=higher. More flagged genes is not automatically better.
findings.required_change: Omit these three ancillary counts from scoped30sample recovery ingestion, or assign a distinct fullcohort evaluation and metric_direction=unknown. Retain numbers unchanged.
